name: dgx-spark-2-deepseek-flash-0731
tagline: Stand up DeepSeek-Flash-0731 on two DGX Spark units, from zero
description: dgx-spark-2-deepseek-flash-0731 is a step-by-step setup guide for getting the DeepSeek-Flash-0731 model running on a pair of NVIDIA DGX Spark machines from a completely blank slate. It walks through the full bring-up path — environment, dependencies, model launch, and getting inference to actually answer — so you avoid the trial-and-error that plagues early on-prem LLM deployments. Written as Shell-focused instructions, it is a practical reference for anyone standing up self-hosted inference on DGX hardware. A niche but genuinely useful companion for the local-Mini-LLM wave.
highlights: From-scratch walkthrough for DeepSeek-Flash-0731 on two DGX Spark nodes
Shell-driven setup covering environment, dependencies, and model launch
Part of the same local-inference wave as h3.c and other mini-LLM projects
High signal for anyone tired of scraping together DGX bring-up docs
curatorNote: DGX Spark is expensive and the docs are thin, so a pragmatic from-zero guide like this is gold for builders. It captures the rising appetite for running serious models on your own hardware instead of paying per token.
